Reproduce the PAC local Explorer integration

Start from Annora Explorer source Git HEAD 8977d5cd4e314f344bcdd086684550b827efc8cb. The copied working tree contained documentation edits; they are not part of this patch.
Apply the accompanying integration.patch from that checkout's root (git apply /path/to/integration.patch). Install pinned dependencies from package-lock.json, then run npm run verify. Copy dist/ into the PAC demo assets/explorer directory and serve it at /explorer/. For GitHub Pages, the PAC project's static exporter adapts the deployment prefix and browser-storage namespace in the generated copy.

Changes: /explorer/ build base; same-origin annoraDemoHost lifecycle hook for parent iframe removal; seller native unsaved-edits dialog handoff; buyer save/leave lifecycle and dirty status; no-wrap Changed label; route-aware retry after initial viewer timeout; eight regression tests. Original renderer, geometry, quotation/review permissions and upstream source are unchanged.

The parent PAC shell must await iframe.contentWindow.annoraDemoHost.beforeLeave() before removing or replacing the frame. Only true permits removal. isDirty() and isBusy() are synchronous and can support the parent beforeunload prompt. No hook on read-only/loading entry is safe to leave. No network delivery or real quotations are introduced.
